cohort: The cohort consisted of 369 postpartum women enrolled within six weeks of delivery from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The prevalence of postnatal depression was 3.25%, with a mean Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale score of 6.78+/-4.33.
mod_finding: Postnatal depression was significantly more frequent in cesarean section patients (5.88%) compared to those with other modes of delivery (1.01%).
